what: Exploration, discovery era 2019-01-04..2022-12-28 only (2023+ sealed): per feature, the +50% hit-rate spread (top fifth or event present minus bottom fifth or absent) inside the Sri Lakshmi G1 pool, within rank bands.

columns.feature: rows.parquet column (units: logs/leader_sleeve/anatomy_1p5x/rows.parquet.manifest.json; delivery columns are 0-1 fractions in the data although that manifest says %)
columns.cov: percent of pool rows where the feature is known
columns.spread_within_rank: percentage points, mean of the three bands
columns.bought_1_9 / r10_25 / r26plus: percentage points within each rank band
columns.years_agree: years of 2019..2022 with the same sign (of 4)
columns.two_se: approximate 2-standard-error band in percentage points for the smallest band

hit: high >= 1.5x the next-open entry within 126 sessions
status: exploration, not a test; 68+ features compared, so some spreads are chance
